verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: built-in metrics that must be enabled in configuration, transcript collection via turn events, and audio recording. Whisker is a pipeline debugger, not an analytics dashboard. Nothing documents ready-made dashboards of call success rates, durations, outcomes or sentiment, in Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see call analytics — success rates, durations, outcomes, sentiment — in dashboards without building my own
